summary: obsidian-tc : Symlink read-ACL scope bypass via lexical path checks
details:
### Impact
ACL checks ran on the lexical vault-relative path while containment used the realpath. An in-vault symlink placed under an allowed glob, whose realpath resolved into a denied folder, passed the read ACL — an intra-vault read-ACL-scope bypass. It requires an out-of-band-planted symlink (no MCP tool creates one) and is not a vault-root escape.

### Patches
Fixed in **1.3.1**. Upgrade to `>= 1.3.1`. ACL enforcement now derives the realpath vault-relative path and feeds a single unified predicate at every site.

### Workarounds
Do not permit untrusted symlinks inside the vault.

Imported from OSV GHSA-c5xx-h28h-f682.
